subject: Film & Cinema
title: Non-Linear Storytelling
description: A quick win: understand Non-Linear Storytelling.

hook.text: Pulp Fiction tells its story out of order — and audiences love piecing it together.

buildup.text: Non-linear scripts shuffle time, using flashbacks, flash-forwards, or parallel timelines.

discovery.text: This structure turns audiences into active participants, solving the narrative puzzle.

twist.text: Used poorly, non-linear storytelling is just confusion. Used well, it's revelation.

climax.text: Memento, Arrival, and Eternal Sunshine all use time as a storytelling tool.

punchline.text: Great stories don't need chronological order.

quiz.question: What does non-linear storytelling require from the audience?
options: Active participation to piece together the narrative
